name: Apache - Detect Web Reconnaissance Scanning
xql_query:
datamodel dataset = apache_httpd_raw
// 1. Explicitly select all relevant XDM fields for SOAR mapping (max 50 fields total)
| fields _time, _product, _vendor, 
xdm.source.ipv4, xdm.source.ipv6, xdm.source.user.username, xdm.source.user_agent, xdm.source.process.pid, xdm.source.process.thread_id,
xdm.source.host.hostname,  xdm.target.ipv4, xdm.target.port, xdm.target.domain,
xdm.network.http.method, xdm.network.http.url, xdm.network.http.referrer, xdm.network.http.response_code,
xdm.target.sent_bytes, xdm.network.tls.protocol_version, xdm.event.log_level, xdm.event.description, xdm.observer.name,
xdm.target.file.path, xdm.target.file.filename
// 2. Filter for 404 Not Found responses
| filter xdm.network.http.response_code = "404"
// 3. Ensure the grouping field is not null
| filter xdm.source.ipv4 != null
// 4. Aggregate the counts by Attacker IP, ensuring key XDM fields are passed via min()
| comp count(_time) as scan_event_count,
values(xdm.network.http.url) as scanned_urls,
values(xdm.source.user_agent) as user_agents_used,
min(_time) as first_occurrence,
max(_time) as last_occurrence,
// --- Contextual XDM Fields carried forward using min() ---
min(xdm.target.ipv4) as server_ip,
min(xdm.target.port) as server_port,
min(xdm.target.domain) as target_domain,
min(xdm.network.http.method) as method,
min(xdm.network.http.referrer) as referrer,
min(xdm.source.user.username) as username,
min(xdm.source.host.hostname) as source_hostname
by xdm.source.ipv4
// 5. Set the threshold for alerting (high volume of failed requests)
| filter scan_event_count >= 10
// 6. Select the aggregated results and grouping fields, retaining full context
| fields *
description: An external IP generated a high volume (>=10) of HTTP 404 responses against the web server - scanning for hidden files, admin pages, or vulnerabilities.
alert_description:
What fired: an external IP produced >=10 HTTP 404 responses against the web server - directory/file enumeration.

Why it matters: web reconnaissance commonly precedes exploitation.

Investigate:
  - Review the mapped source IP, the scanned URLs and user agents on this alert.
  - Check whether any request later returned 200 (successful discovery) and whether the same IP appears in exploit attempts.

MITRE ATT&CK: T1595 - Active Scanning (TA0043 - Reconnaissance).
